programme.title: Dyrenes sanser
programme.desc: Den første sansen som ble utviklet hos de første dyrene, var kjemoresepsjon – evnen til å oppdage kjemikalier i dyrets omgivelser. Dette hjelper dyrene med å finne byttedyr og maker, og å merke rovdyr på avstand.

programme.title: Havparker
programme.desc: Exuma Cays er et avsidesliggende vidunder med hundrevis av små øyer som strekker seg sørover fra hovedstaden på Bahamas, Nassau. På 1950-tallet drømte utviklere om å bygge ut denne vakre og stort sett uutforskede regionen. Men før byggingen tok til, ga den bahamanske regjeringen støtte til en ekspedisjon for å kartlegge korallrevet. De likte det de så, og i 1959 opprettet de Bahamas National Trust og grunnla den første havparken på Bahamas.

programme.title: Dyrelivet på Madagaskar
programme.desc: Se hvordan de kaldblodige dyrene på Madagaskar lever. Kameleoner, frosker, firfisler og slanger har alle tilpasset seg for å overleve på øya. Vi ser nærmere på hvordan de finner mat, formerer seg og unngår rovdyr.

programme.title: Nykommere i villmarken
programme.desc: Jaguarungen Frida tester grenser og finpusser overlevelsesevnene sine i Caiman Lodge naturreservat i Brasil. Hun lærer seg å snike seg fram sammen med mamma Gatuna, får hjelp av søster Anouk til å gjemme seg for sultne inntrengere, og tar en dumdristig tur alene som heldigvis ender godt.

programme.title: Nykommere i villmarken
programme.desc: Sjøløven Lola tar sine første kaotiske steg inn på en mannsdominert slagmark på kysten av Argentina. Den unge sjøløven lærer seg livsviktige kommunikasjons- og svømmeferdigheter, kjemper for å bli hos moren Maria, og unnslipper så vidt et sett skarpe tenner.

programme.title: Nykommere i villmarken
programme.desc: Føl fortryllelsen av Brasils Atlanterhavsskog når ulledderkoppen Dora tar sine første skritt bort fra mamma Mimi. Få leksjoner i apedynamikk, øv deg på halehengingsteknikk, og se denne babyen finne sin plass blant jevnaldrende.

programme.title: Nykommere i villmarken
programme.desc: Sett kursen mot eventyr med Thiago, en modig nesebjørn. Finn ut hvordan denne vaskebjørn-lignende karen skjerper sine snuse- og leteferdigheter, krysser forstadsveier i nærheten av sitt frodige brasilianske skoghjem og unngår livløse og firbeinte farer.

programme.title: Nykommere i villmarken
programme.desc: Besøk den siste høyborgen til den gigantiske elveoteren i Brasils vakre Pantanal-våtmark. Spor valpen Rio og søsknene hans mens de tester vannet, slår seg sammen for å unngå et angrep fra jaguarer og bli en familieenhet som jakter og vokser sammen.

programme.title: Gjengene på Lemurøya
programme.desc: Presset for å finne mat når nye høyder og kaster reservatet ut i uro. Vitnebrudd dukker opp i rekkene, deler gjengene og leder Crystal, den ukuelige lederen av Ruins-gjengen, til å møte den største utfordringen så langt.

programme.title: Den blå villmarken
programme.desc: Den ville kysten i Sør-Afrika strekker seg over 170 mil. Her møtes vannet i det indiske hav og Atlanterhavet, og tvinger kraftige bølger mot kysten. Det er her den Mosambik-baserte djevelskate-forskeren Andrea Marshall håper å gjennomføre sin første djevelskate-ekspedisjon noensinne innenfor Sør-Afrikas grenser...

programme.title: Den blå villmarken
programme.desc: Den ville kystlinjen i Mosambik strekker seg over mer enn 1600 mil, et område som myldrer av et mangfold av marint liv. Noen av verdens største filtermatere tiltrekkes av dette næringsrike vannet. Men selv disse store skapningene er forsvarsløse mot hensynsløst overfiske. To av Mosambiks ledende havforskere, Andrea Marshall og Nakia Cullain, satte ut for å finne et av havets mest hemmelighetsfulle dyr og beskytte dets mest kjente, før det er for sent.

programme.title: Den blå villmarken
programme.desc: Kysten av Mosambik er hjemsted for kjemper, som pukkelrygger og hvalhaier, men de minste artene spiller en like stor rolle i økosystemet. Møt forskerne som jobber mot klokken for å beskytte kystdyr, både store og små.

programme.title: Den blå villmarken
programme.desc: Havet strekker seg over 70 prosent av planeten vår og er hjemsted for så mange som én million kjente arter med planter og dyr. Imidlertid er det den minste av havdyrene som ligger til grunn for verdens største næringsnett, nemlig planktonen. Disse mikroskopiske organismene driver gjennom havets forskjellige habitater, og utløser fôringssykluser i kjølvannet deres. Uten dem ville livet i havet slutte å eksistere.

programme.title: Vill himmel
programme.desc: Følg med på den australske himmelen, som jevnlig serverer noe av verdens mest ustabile vær. Vent på kjølende monsunregn, se lyn som starter store skogbranner og la deg imponere av de geniale tilpasningene som hjelper dyrene gjennom ekstremværet.

programme.title: Vill himmel
programme.desc: Opplev det kraftfulle, fargerike fenomenet som glir over himmelen i Nord-Amerika. Se isbjørner på jakt etter mat under nordlyset, se nærmere på forflytningen til en polarvirvel, og unngå voldsomme tornadoer sammen med en præriehundfamilie.

programme.title: Vill himmel
programme.desc: Få med deg den evige jakten på vann som definerer livet til Afrikas ville dyr. Vær vitne til det største marine etegildet på Jorden, se hvordan kobraer samler solkraft, og bli med en flokk gnuer og elefanter på en av sine store vandringer.

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Utforsk hvordan månefaser setter rytmen for en endeløs konkurranse mellom rovdyr og bytte. Fly i måneskinnet med skjermflygere, fet deg opp på skalldyrfest med makakene, og se en jaktende flokk med løver som prøver å få en babyelefant til middag.

programme.title: Havets merkeligste skapninger
programme.desc: Bli kjent med en rekke rare skapninger i havet, og se hvordan milliarder av år med endringer, fra istider til asteroider, har formet utseendet og ferdighetene deres. Møt blinde marker som fisker, haier som kan gå, krabber som klatrer i trær og mye mer.

programme.title: Havets merkeligste skapninger
programme.desc: Kjærligheten i det merkelige, men fine samarbeidet mellom noen av jordas rareste skapninger er til å ta og føle på. Ta et dypdykk for å se besynderlige dyr, fra bitende reker til ulveåler, gi en håndsrekning til andre raringer i havet for å sørge for at alle overlever.

programme.title: Havets merkeligste skapninger
programme.desc: Finn din indre science fiction-fan og bli kjent med de besynderlige paringsritualene til de rareste skapningene i havet. Finn ut hvordan blodige kamper om en make, utradisjonelle kjønnsroller og enorme babyflokker kan sørge for at disse dyrene får en ny generasjon.

programme.title: Roy Ayers . Bayfront Jazz Festival 2021
programme.desc: Roy Ayers . Bayfront Jazz Festival 2021Miami, 2021Directed by Amos RozenbergThe 2021 inaugural edition of the Bayfront Jazz Festival takes place in Miami's Bayfront Park. The festival's mission is to honor and celebrate the current and future giants of Jazz, Afro-Cuban, Latin and electronic music. This year's unique line-up includes Roy Ayers, Dee Dee Bridgewater, Chucho Valdés, Gonzalo Rubalcaba & Aymée Nuviola and Mark Guiliana's Beat Music. One of the most visible and winning vibraphonists since the 1960s and part of the Bayfront Jazz Festival 2021 is Roy Ayers. Ayers' 1976 neo-soul album Everybody Loves the Sunshine is one of the most heavily sampled record in hip-hop history.

programme.title: Steinway & Sons
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes at the Steinway & Sons factory and discover Spirio, the incredible technology that allows a piano to replay a performance exactly as it was played live. Mr. Guido Zimmermann, the president of the world-famous pianomakers, talks us through the revolutionary concept, accompanied by images of the precise, fascinating craftmanship and engineering that goes into each one of the Spirio pianos. Hugo Cohen Sprung's documentary also allows us insight into French pianist and Steinway artist Bertrand Chamayou's experience with the technology and features a preview of his unique two-piano concert in which he performs with his "shadow"!

Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Photo Contest

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Caravaggio. You will discover his labour with Bacchus, Mary Magdalene or Christ at the Column.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: David Hockney à la Royal Academy of Arts
programme.desc: David Hockney, généralement considéré comme l’un des artistes britanniques les plus populaires, connaît un succès mondial grâce à ses expositions à Londres, New York, Paris et ailleurs qui attirent des millions de spectateurs. Devenu récemment octogénaire, Hockney ne semble pas avoir l’intention de lever le pied ni de perdre son audace légendaire. Ce film révèle des interviews intimes et inédites et se concentre sur deux expositions à succès ayant eu lieu en 2012 et 2016 à la Royal Academy of Arts Londres. Le réalisateur Phil Grabsky a bénéficié d’un accès privilégié pour célébrer sur grand écran ce génie créatif du XXIe siècle.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Eugène Delacroix is considered as the leader of French Romanticism, a simultaneously passionate, dramatic and tormented artistic movement, which emerged at the beginning of the 19th century. However, more than a movement, it is a whole creative and captivating artistic development, which is on offer here, through the study of 10 of the artist’s major works. He was to have a notable influence on all modern artistic movements, which after him, were to explore the power of colour and light. Discover " Liberty leading the people " or " The death of Sardanapalus " exposed at the Louvre.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Named Euphrosyne, Thalia and Aglaia, they embody mirth, abundance and splendour. They are the Three Graces, daughters of Jupiter and companions of Venus. A very prized subject as early as the Renaissance, it allowed for a triple representation of the female nude in all its ideal beauty. Observe their grace in the painting by Raphael and the delicacy of their veils in Botticelli’s “La Primavera” or in a magnificent work by Cranach recently acquired by the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Que faire de nos morts ? Les brûler ? Les enterrer ? Les faire disparaître ? Les garder à portée de visite ? Nous sommes à 70km de Barcelone, derrière le Montserrat. Ici, comme dans toute l’Espagne, on n’enterre pas les morts, on les empile dans des niches, des caveaux superposés. Ainsi, le nouveau cimetière d’Igualada sera l’œuvre d’un couple d’architectes Catalans au tout début de leur carrière, Enric Miralles et Carme Pinos. Un projet surprenant parce qu’il se confond avec le paysage. Le terrain est creusé, habité d’étranges alignements aux parois obliques en béton, recouverts de terre et plantés. Est-ce un bâtiment ? Ou plutôt un lieu ? Un lieu qui s’est enrichi du fait même qu’il n’est pas fini ? Une inscription forte entre architecture du XXème siècle et paysage, entre Le Corbusier et Richard Long.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: King Philip IV of Spain’s portrait painter, Diego Velazquez, (1599-1660) is the archetype of the brilliant court painter and alone embodies the stunning Spanish school of the “golden” 17th century. Admired for the psychological reality of his portraits, particularly that of “Pope Innocent X” belonging to the Doria Pamphilj Gallery, he is above all known for his masterpieces on display in the Museo del Prado, particularly “Las Meninas” where he represents himself beside the infant and her retinue. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Dans la seconde moitié du 19ème siècle, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) démontre une grande originalité dans ses peintures à représentation historique et ses portraits représentant des figures connues, comme le romancier Zola et le poète Mallarmé. Même s’il n’est pas reconnu comme étant le premier impressionniste, sa place de leader dans l’histoire de l’art se doit d’être souligné. Les scandales provoqués en 1863 par « Le Déjeuner sur l’herbe » ou « Olympia » tout deux exposés au Musée d'Orsay marque le début de la peinture moderne.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Secret treasures
programme.desc: Secret treasures takes you on a journey to discover the unsuspected secrets and treasures of the National Assembly in France. Some of the most delicate works are kept in the greatest secrecy. But this place, which is the temple of the French democracy, opens its doors to us exceptionally today. We will make you discover this emblematic universe, more known for its political episodes than for the treasures that it shelters.

programme.title: Secret treasures
programme.desc: Secret treasures makes you discover the Bibliotheque Thiers in Paris. It is a place that houses many treasures that we do not suspect the existence. Today, we will visit this exceptional place which is the property of the Institute of France in search of the treasures it contains. Experts, historians, librarians, will guide us through the corridors and floors of this magical place.

programme.title: Paris under Japanese influence
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Japanese architects think about reinventing Paris drawing Metabolism, which converts Japanese megalopolis like Tokyo.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the drawing and paper cut exhibition at the Rodin Museum. This exhibition brings together a hundred paper cut-outs and drawings of the artist. These artistic practices have accompanied him throughout his life. Among the works exhibited you will find drawings such as "The Mask of Minos" and many paper cut-outs representing bodies. But it should not be forgotten that Rodin was also a sculptor and you will be able to observe sculptures with Japanese influences such as the "face expressing fury".

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: C’est l’un des artistes les plus controversés et pourtant, l’un des plus influents. La collection de Picasso contenait principalement des Renoir. Matisse le vénérait. Monet également. Renoir a été crucial dans la création du mouvement impressionniste, avant de le rejeter totalement pour se lancer dans un genre radicalement différent, avec beaucoup de succès. La Collection Barnes à Philadelphie possède plus de toiles de Renoir que n’importe quelle autre galerie au monde et c’est là que nous tenterons de lever le voile sur l’histoire remarquable de cet incroyable artiste.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Sandro Botticelli.You will discover his labour with Abundance or autumn, The story of virginia, Venus and Mars.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Leonardo da Vinci.You will discover his labour with the Joconde, Salvator Mundi, The Cène.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: L’art d’Edgar Degas est difficile à classer, cependant il est souvent associé au mouvement impressionniste, qui a émergé en France à la fin du 19ème siècle. Néanmoins, il a développé un style très personnel avec une préférence pour les sujets intérieurs plutôt que les scènes en plein air favorisées par les peintres impressionnistes. Les 10 oeuvres présentées dans cet épisode illustrent parfaitement les préférences thématiques d’Edgar Degas : Le spectacle, le bain, les portraits de famille et les classes de travail. Découvrez " La Classe de danse " exposé au Musée d'Orsay ou encore " Les Danseuses bleues " au Musée des Beaux-Arts Pouchkine.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Art Quiz
programme.desc: Test your knowledge and your memory in fine arts, architecture, photography, street art and a dozen other topics with our Art Quiz popups !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Centre Administratif de Pantin, a gigantic vessel of raw concrete, washed up on the banks of the Ourcq Canal in the early 1970s, in a Paris suburb known as the “Red Belt”.Its architect, Jacques Kalisz, had not yet built anything. Sensitive to Marxist theories, he had no formal qualifications at the time. The mayor of Pantin commissioned him to design an unprecedented facility, the Cité Administrative, which was to bring together a range of administrative, social and legal services (court, social security, police station, tax office, trade union center, ANPE, morgue, kennels, etc.), all in a single location. 20 years later, the center is deserted. It was the failure of a social utopia. The “People's Palace” is nothing but an empty shell. Destroying it would have been too expensive. So it was decided to renovate it.In 2004, the building underwent a radical change of use: offices and employees gave way to dance companies and rehearsal studios. A new cultural center, the Centre Nat.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Roissy 1 a incarné les aspirations de l’architecture moderne. C’était les premiers temps du voyage de masse, une époque d’avant la crise, qui croyait au progrès et rêvait de vitesse. Ce fut également l’entrée en scène de l’architecture dans la construction d’aérogares. Avec Roissy 1, ce ne sont plus les avions mais l’architecture qu’on viendra admirer.Paul Andreu fut le principal acteur de cette révolution. Il avait alors 29 ans, c’était sa 1ère construction – le tout début d’une longue série d’une cinquantaine de plateformes dans le monde entier qui fera de lui un des plus grands architectes d’aérogares du XXème siècle.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The Boy with a Soap Bubble, Rembrandt
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris
programme.desc: In 2010, five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse, Braque, Modigliani and Léger went missing. A year into the investigation, the police arrested the burglar, Vrejan Tomic. A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Claude Monet est probablement le peintre impressionniste le plus célèbre du mouvement. Le terme « impressionnisme » est notamment dérive d’une de ses peintures « Impression, soleil levant » (1872). Cette exposition retrace les grandes étapes de la carrière prolifique de Monet tout en se concentrant sur les tableaux de ce maître de l’art à ne pas manquer comme : « La Gare Saint-Lazare », « Les Coquelicots », « Les Meules », « Série des Cathédrales de Rouen » exposé dans les 4 coins du monde comme au Musée des Beaux-arts de Boston et sans oublier « Les Nymphéas » exposé au musée de l'Orangerie à Paris.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « Les Tournesols » sont parmi les tableaux de Van Gogh les plus célèbres. Le musée Van Gogh à Amsterdam a consacré une exposition à ces œuvres et « Exhibition on screen », qui a eu un accès exclusif à l’événement, nous guide à travers l’exposition pour enquêter sur les mystères qui entourent ces tableaux. Le film nous amènera également à Tokyo, Philadelphie, Londres et Munich pour suivre les 5 principales œuvres de l’exposition.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Painting the Modern Garden - Monet to Matisse
programme.desc: Passionné d’horticulture, Monet reste sans conteste le maître de la peinture de jardins dans l’histoire de l’art, mais il n’était pas seul. Des artistes tels que Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso et Matisse ont utilisé le jardin comme thème fort de leur œuvre. Ces grands artistes, ainsi que bien d’autres noms célèbres, sont rassemblés dans une exposition innovante du Cleveland Museum of Art et de la Royal Gallery of Arts de Londres. De l’exposition elle-même à la beauté des jardins d’artistes comme celui de Monet à Giverny, nous partons en voyage pour découvrir comment le jardin moderne était utilisé pour explorer de nouvelles idées radicales et merveilleuses.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Painting the Holy Land
programme.desc: Lachlan traces the story of Mary through the gospels with a personal question: why is the life of the Mother of God barely described in the Bible, but so well-represented in art?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « J’envie les Japonais », écrivait Van Gogh à son frère, Théo. Grâce à l’exposition sur laquelle est basé ce film, « Van Gogh et le Japon », au musée Van Gogh d’Amsterdam, on comprend pourquoi. Bien que Vincent van Gogh n’ait jamais visité le Japon, il reste le pays qui a eu le plus d’influence sur lui et son œuvre. En se rendant dans les galeries d’art japonais à Paris et en créant sa propre image du Japon après des recherches approfondies, des collections d’estampes et de longues discussions avec d’autres artistes, la découverte des œuvres japonaises entraîna la carrière de Van Gogh dans une nouvelle direction très excitante.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Villa Dall’Ava, designed by Rem Koolhaas in 1991, is an iconic project located on the heights of Saint-Cloud, near Paris. This house is distinguished by its bold architecture and geometric forms that challenge the traditional conventions of a typical villa. The structure consists of shifted volumes, with two apartment boxes appearing to float above the pool, creating an impression of lightness.Koolhaas faced significant technical and aesthetic challenges during the design of the villa. On one hand, he dealt with opposition from neighbors concerned about the visual and structural impact of the house on the surrounding landscape. On the other hand, he had to devise ingenious solutions to support the weight of the boxes and the pool, which holds 65 tons of water. The villa incorporates carefully planned internal supports and a drainage system to ensure the stability of the structure.In addition to these challenges, Villa Dall’Ava serves as a reflection on modern living and the rel.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Le street Art s’est, depuis les années 1980, glissé dans les villes et ses artistes s’octroient une place grandissante dans l’espace urbain, mais aussi dans les collections d’art. Installé à Lille, Jef Aerosol fait partie des historiques du Street Art français avec option pochoir. Son genre, c’est le portrait, et il a longtemps puisé dans l’univers musical pour décliner sa passion. L’artiste est collectionné aujourd’hui par les plus grands amateurs de Street Art.

programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Leftovers often end up in the garbage can. But with a little thought, it's easy to recycle them. This ecological and economical gesture can even delight our taste buds. Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan panacakes.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.sub-title: Dietary Supplements: Healthy Dose of Misinformation?
programme.desc: Dietary Supplements: Helpful or Dangerous?They’re flooding the shelves of pharmacies, supermarkets, and health food stores. Brewer’s yeast, vitamins, passionflower, spirulina… More than one in two French people have already taken dietary supplements to get back in shape or stay healthy.A capsule for memory, a tablet for stress, a herbal detox programme… The promises made by dietary supplements are tempting. These products are guaranteed to be 100 per cent natural, which stands in stark contrast to the chemical image associated with medicines. But are they really effective and safe?The range of dietary supplements on offer is vast, with over 150 million packs sold in France every year. As summer approaches, many female consumers turn to slimming products. programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.sub-title: Bipolar Disorder: From One Extreme to the Other
programme.desc: Are We All Bipolar?We all experience mood swings in life. But when emotions become too intense, leading to uncontrollable reactions and all kinds of extreme behavior, we’re talking about bipolar disorder—a condition that affects more than one million people in France.In recent years, this disorder has regularly been in the media spotlight. Benoît Poelvoorde, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Jim Carrey… Many are said to suffer from bipolar disorder and have spoken openly about it. Yet, far from being a passing fad, it is a serious and highly debilitating mental illness.Switching from euphoria to depression in a matter of days is what characterizes this disorder, formerly known as manic-depressive psychosis. Excitement, grandiose plans, sadness, and an inability to experience pleasure are the lot of patients who must learn to manage these erratic moods.Despite these signs, it takes more than 10 years on average for a diagnosis to be made. programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Kamuflasje, mimikk og sniking er verktøy som brukes av de smarteste dyrene på planeten. programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Enten de skal unnslippe farlige rovdyr eller bekjempe tøffe rivaler, så er ikke alltid rå styrke nok til å lykkes. Vi møter noen av planetens mest unike dyr som tar i bruk utrolige superkrefter, som akrobatikk som trosser døden, hemmelige sanser og skjulte våpen, for å overleve.

programme.title: Noe bet meg!

programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: Helt siden oldtiden har mennesker hatt et brokete forhold til slanger. På tvers av Amerika og Australia huser ulike habitater giftige hoggormer og kraftfulle kvelerslanger, som alle har utviklet seg til å tilpasse seg sin nisje. I Amerika holder over 30 ulike typer klapperslanger gnagerbestanden under kontroll, og bevarer økosystemer. Mens i Australia skjuler korallrevene enda farligere sjøslanger og den sky og ekstremt giftige kysttaipanen. Fra frodige skoger til ørkensanden huser disse kontinentene en skjult verden av noen av de mest dødelige, fascinerende og hemmelighetsfulle slangene.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin drar dypt inn i Australias mangroveskog, og leter etter utrolige dyr som nyter sumplivet. Han vasser gjennom gjørme, og møter en hissig mangrovekrabbe med livsfarlige klør før han fanger en shovel-nosed ray med bare hendene. Phil har hele tiden følge av verdens mest forhatte skapning – myggen.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: På et dypdykk i Australias hav leter Phil Breslin etter de ville dyrene som dominerer undervannsverdenen. Først finner han en jeger som er bygget som en torpedo og utstyrt med dolker – tigerhaien. Så dykker Phil med en gruppe grasiøse djevelskater, og får høre en serenade fra verdens største skapning, den majestetiske knølhvalen.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Vest i Middelhavet ligger Portugal, med et mangfold av økosystemer som huser et imponerende rikt dyreliv. Mange av artene finnes bare i denne delen av verden og er tett knyttet sammen i et økosystem som gir dyrene grunnlag for å overleve i et til tider krevende landskap. En ildsalamander, som kan bli opptil 50 år gammel, nyter sitt første måltid etter å ha tilbrakt den tørre sommeren i dvale under jorden. Iberiagaupa, en av verdens sjeldneste villkatter, jakter på favorittbyttet sitt, kanin. Kongeørn og rev, som vanligvis er rivaler, tolererer hverandre lenge nok til å dele et bytte. Samtidig forbereder unge pyreneersteinbukker seg på voksenlivet ved å bryne hornene mot hverandre i en imponerende styrkeprøve.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Langs Portugals kyst er livet både vakkert og brutalt for de unike artene som lever der, fra mikroskopisk planteplankton til enorme spermhvaler. Vinkekrabbene kjemper om retten til å pare seg i kystlagunene. Sepiablekksprutenen, en mester i kamuflasje, sniker seg inn på intetanende byttedyr. Storker bygger reir på de bratte klippene langs Atlanterhavskysten og vokter ungene sine mot rovdyr.

programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: Helt siden oldtiden har mennesker hatt et brokete forhold til slanger. programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: På tvers av Afrikas vidstrakte landskap finnes et flott utvalg av habitater som huser giftige slanger og ikoniske kvelerslanger, som alle er perfekt tilpasset sin nisje. Midt i Sør-Afrika skremmer den fryktede svarte mambaen en elefantfamilie før den snor seg inn i en anspent duell om en kresen make. Kobraer barker sammen med rivaler, til og med andre kobraer, og viser frem hetter som signaliserer hastighet og ustoppelig kraft. Og i Egypts brennende hete og sand, er det de smarte huggormene som overlever og får regjere – ikke på grunn av størrelse eller styrke, men med mesterlig kamuflasje og gift som blir levert med presisjon.

programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: På tvers av Asia og Europa er varierte habitater hjemmet til giftige ormer, ikoniske kobraer og kraftfulle kvelerslanger, som alle er perfekt tilpasset til sin nisje. Høyt oppe i trærne ligger hoggormene på Shedao-øya på lur, klare for å fange bytter i luften. Mangshan-hoggormen, et utviklingsmessig mesterverk, forfølger bytter mens den sømløst går i ett med mosen rundt dem. Og dypt inne i skogen beviser en burmesisk dvergpyton at noen ganger hastighet og styrke alt som trengs for å sikre seg et godt måltid.

programme.title: Venom Files - Anatomy of a Snake Bite
programme.desc: Millioner blir bitt av slanger hvert år, selv om giften deres ble utviklet for jakt, og ikke for å skade mennesker. Utforsk de fascinerende og livsfarlige tilpasningene til kongekobraen, den svarte mambaen, innlandstaipanen, hvesehuggormen, efanen, spyttekobraen og den skremmende boomslangen. Reis fra Indias livlige landsbyer til Afrikas ville busklandskap og Australias villmark for å være vitne til hvordan gift paralyserer, fordøyer og beskytter – og hvordan våre verdener kolliderer på overraskende måter. Hver slanges gift forteller en historie, utviklet for å jakte, beskytte og overleve. Men når mennesker og slanger møtes, bringer kjemien som tidligere sørget for balanse kaos. “Venom Files” avslører naturens farligste mordere.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Etter knall og fall redder dr. Pol og veterinærene alt fra gekkoer til geiter på klinikken. En gris med prolaps, en haug med valper og en kommende veterinær holder hjulene i gang. Dr. Pol behandler en dachs som har vært i slåsskamp, dr. Lisa bistår en geit med fødselen og dr. Nicole fjerner spikeren i hoven til en hest. Så får Pol-familien gledelige babynyheter.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Klinikken tar imot hele seks kull med hundevalper til undersøkelser. Hunden Teddy har en mystisk lidelse, og dr. Lisa prøver å redde beinet til en katt. Rotta Simba får hjelp av dr. Nicole, mens dr. Brenda drar til to gårder. Veterinærene på Pols klinikk gir seg aldri.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: Den mystiske kysten langs Skjelettkysten i Namibia er bakteppe for et gripende virkelighetsdrama om tre ville, foreldreløse ørkenløveunger. Vi følger den fantastiske historien deres om motstandsdyktighet og overlevelse i et av de dødeligste områdene i verden, fra de første ustødige skrittene midt i ørkenen til det å lære å jakte langs kysten.

programme.title: Dødelige slanger
programme.desc: Utsyrt med en kraftig nevrotoksisk gift dreper en familie av slanger flere mennesker enn noen annet på jorden. Forskere over hele verden jobber hardt for å avdekke hvordan.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin drar til den australske savannen på jakt etter landets mest formidable skapninger. Senere står han ansikt til ansikt med en krageagam og dens fascinerende forsvarsmekanismer.

programme.title: Kannibalhai
programme.desc: Verdens fremste haiforskere leder en gransking av den fascinerende verdenen til kannibalhaier. Fra den 50 cm lange sigarhaien som river ut biter av hvithaien som er ti ganger så stor, til sandtigerhai-unger som angriper og spiser hverandre inne i mors mage. Stålsett deg til å se haier som du aldri har sett dem før.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I denne spesialepisoden møter vi noen av de sjeldneste og farligste dyrene som har tilpasset seg livet i Kinas mest ekstreme naturområder. I de avsidesliggende fjellene må rovdyr og åtseletere kjempe hardt for hvert måltid. Høyt oppe i jungelens trekroner bærer en hornfugl familiens framtid i nebbet. I fjellskogene kjemper gylne stumpneseaper om retten til å føre slekten videre, mens farene lurer overalt på de eldgamle gresslettene.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Når savannen blir en slagmark ser vi på fra sidelinjen når en leopard blir trengt opp i et hjørne av en løveflokk. En ung impala blir kastet opp i luften av en flodhest, to hyener prøver å drukne hverandre og et jordsvin står ansikt til ansikt med en brunhyene.

programme.title: Kannibalhai
programme.desc: Verdens fremste haiforskere leder en gransking av den fascinerende verdenen til kannibalhaier. I fjellskogene kjemper gylne stumpneseaper om retten til å føre slekten videre, mens farene lurer overalt på de eldgamle gresslettene.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I Kinas skoger, jungler og høye fjell lever noen av verdens mest besynderlige og vakreste skapninger. I disse skjulte rikene krever kampen for å overleve ofte helt unike tilpasninger. En ung panda får sin første klatreundervisning, fargerike larver viser fram sine iøynefallende mønster, og verdens eneste giftige primat, dovenlorien, sniker seg til et lite måltid. De utrolige historiene gir et sjeldent innblikk i en bemerkelsesverdig verden.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Doc og Diane ønsker en ny frieser-unghoppe velkommen. Dr. Lisa håndterer to corgi-nødstilfeller. Dr. Olivia får hjelp med behandlingen av to hunder med merkelige sår.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: I denne episoden hjelper dr. Pol en merr som har satt noe i halsen, dr. Brenda ser til en halt ku og dr. Lisa behandler en okse. På klinikken tar man imot flere hunder: en chihuahua som har brukket beinet, en drektig tispe og en dobermann med kuler i ansiktet. Men uansett hva det gjelder, så stiller veterinærene alltid opp.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: I dag er klinikken travlere enn noensinne når Dr. Pol og teamet må håndtere flere hastesaker etter hverandre. Dyrlegene lapper sammen en skadet hund, ser til kosete chinchillaer, hjelper en svært oppblåst okse og fikser smerter i noens bak.

programme.title: Return of the White Shark
programme.desc: Hvithaiene dukker opp i stadig større antall ved det populære feriestedet Cape Cod, der det i flere hundre år ikke var noen. Med fantastiske bilder undersøker man hvordan kystlandskapet har forandret seg med tiden og hvorfor det finnes rekordmange hvithaier her.

programme.title: Gigantiske haier
programme.desc: Norfolkøyene er hjemsted for de største tigerhaiene på jorden, men hvorfor er de så store? Forskerne mistenker en uvanlig diett av kassert storfekjøtt.

programme.title: Kannibalhai
programme.desc: Verdens fremste haiforskere leder en gransking av den fascinerende verdenen til kannibalhaier. programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Det blir sett flere og flere hvithaier i Atlanterhavet utenfor Canada, og marinbiolog Alanna Canaran drar ut for å avsløre gåtene rundt disse fantastiske skapningene. Canaran og teamet hennes kjemper for å finne sky haier og navigere farlige farvann for å samle uvurderlige data som forhåpentligvis kan bidra til at mennesker og hvithaier kan sameksistere fredfullt.

programme.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory drar til Baja-halvøya i Mexico for å finne et av havets mest særegne rovdyr: hammerhaien. En gang var den et vanlig syn, men nå har bestanden stupt. Bertie undersøker hvorfor, og om det er noe håp for den ikoniske haien.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter One: A Prince Is Born
programme.desc: Den forsiktige løveungen Kio er sønnen til Summer, dronningen av en mektig flokk. Han blir født inn i en verden der hver lærdom har en pris. En dag skal han kanskje herske over sitt eget rike, men først må han lære å overleve. En tragisk bøffeljakt gir ham et første innblikk i hvor uforutsigbart livet på savannen er. Han blir stadig modigere, og hver utfordring tar ham lenger bort fra flokkens trygghet – helt til et eventyr på egen hånd fører ham rett i veien for flokkens største fiende: bøflene.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Afrikas farlige rike
programme.desc: På sørkysten av Afrika finner vi noen av verdens mest varierte og dynamiske rev. En vakker og svært mystisk undervannsverden med et mangfoldig dyreliv. Vi dykker ned under bølgene for å avsløre de utrolige skapningene som lever blant korallene.
